name: bigface-theme
description: Bigface — one dark palette, ported to the tools you use

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck && bun run --cwd site typecheck && bun run lint && bun test src site/src packages/ui/src
scripts.brand: uv run --with cairosvg --with pillow python3 brand/export-avatar.py
scripts.brand:check: uv run --with cairosvg --with pillow python3 brand/validate-avatar.py
